text:
Find the total quantity of each SKU across all warehouses. Print one line per SKU whose total is at least 50, formatted as `<sku> <total>`, sorted by total descending, then by SKU ascending for ties.

Example of the format (made-up values):
```
rod-8 120
bracket-2 50
```
tools: Stock records held in one warehouse. A warehouse may hold no stock.
expected:
bolt-m4 75
nut-m4 75
washer-10 65
gear-12t 50
hinge-50 50
spring-s 50
